name: The Final Page
source:
Back here another day. I wonder how things are gonna go today. Time to greet my friends before classes start. I might not have much time for them but they're important to me. Right?
...
Heading to my class again. Let's see what new things l discover about him.

[From [url=https://5naf-plushies.itch.io/tfp]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新的一天又回到了这里。不知道今天会过得怎么样。趁还没开始上课，先去跟朋友们打个招呼吧。我或许没多少时间陪他们，但他们对我来说很重要。对吧？
……
又要去教室上课了。看看今天我能发现关于他的什么新鲜事吧。

[引自[url=https://5naf-plushies.itch.io/tfp]Itch.io[/url]]
